description.p: Prepare your camera and microphone for calls, streams, and local recordings. Blur, replace, or remove your camera background, clean up microphone noise, and transcribe meetings locally after downloading a speech model.

This Flatpak uses CPU processing on x86_64 computers. It includes camera effects, microphone processing, MP4 recording, and local meeting tools. NVIDIA GPU processing modes are not included in this package.
Virtual-camera output requires a v4l2loopback device configured on the host. The application needs direct camera and audio access. It cannot install host drivers from inside its sandbox.
NV Broadcast is an independent community project by Doczeus. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or distributed by NVIDIA Corporation.

description.p: Camera, audio, and preview controls fit small windows. Recordings retain complete video and audio across effect changes, and saved files are accessible from the Recordings menu. Camera discovery and processing recovery are improved.
